title: Boy and man killed, 10 injured after woman drives through youth soccer game in Wichita, Kansas - NBC News
description: A 6-year-old boy and 35-year-old man were killed, and 10 others were injured, when a woman drove a truck through a youth soccer game at a city sports complex in Wichita, Kansas, Saturday afternoon, police said.
